findings.failure_scenario: IndexOrdinalRegistry.ordinalFor() holds its synchronized lock across the entire read-modify-CAS-retry cycle, including network calls, for the whole instance regardless of which indexUUID is being registered. A burst of many distinct new indices registered through one shared instance serializes to one in-flight registration at a time. Does not violate request-rate scaling (still O(distinct new indices)); a latency/throughput tradeoff, not a defect, and plausible given ADR-0008 frames this workload as rare.
